page_title: COM 2-1 NAP | Como v Napoli 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' Gianluca Manganiello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' What a chance that is! Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
90+3' The foul by Anastasios Douvikas (Como) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is coming onto the pitch as Gabriel Strefezza cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Nico Paz.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
85' Alieu Fadera (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Napoli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
84' Substitution. Noah Okafor (Napoli) on for Stanislav Lobotka.
83' Scott McTominay (Napoli) sees a yellow card from Gianluca Manganiello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
81' Substitution. Lucas Da Cunha makes way for Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
81' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Alieu Fadera (Como) replaces Assane Diao.
77' A substitution has been made. Matteo Politano goes off and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) comes on.
77' 2 - 1 Assane Diao (Como) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
75' Great touch by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
74' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Patrick Cutrone (Como) coming on for Maxence Caqueret.

71' Poor effort! The corner picks out Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
71' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
70' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

69' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Gianluca Manganiello shows the yellow card to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) for a heavy challenge.
67' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
67' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
67' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

66' Superb touch by Scott McTominay (Napoli) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save! Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
62' Here is a change. Philip Billing is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Frank Anguissa (Napoli).
62' Substitution. Romelu Lukaku is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
61' The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' Cesc Fabregas is stunned as referee Gianluca Manganiello shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
57' Surely that's handball by one of the Napoli players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
55' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
52' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
48' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Referee Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
44' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Gianluca Manganiello had a clear view and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Como.
42' 38:62 – the ratio of ball possession.

40' Great solo effort from Assane Diao (Como)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
39' Philip Billing (Napoli) commits a foul and Gianluca Manganiello immediately signals a free kick.
38' Assane Diao (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
37' Alex Valle (Como) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Como are going to take it.
34' Dangerous play by Ivan Smolcic (Como). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
33' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
30' The resulting corner from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Napoli have a corner.
28' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
27' A neat pass is well received by Alex Valle (Como), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
25' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Nico Paz (Como) for a tough tackle.
23' 0:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
22' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
22' Ivan Smolcic (Como) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Como earn a corner.
17' 1 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 1:1.
15' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Gianluca Manganiello who sees an offensive foul. Napoli earn a free kick.

13' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
13' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) prepares to take a corner kick.

13' Philip Billing (Napoli) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Jean Butez to dive and make a save. The referee points to the corner flag and Napoli will take a corner.
11' Maxence Caqueret (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Gianluca Manganiello signals. Napoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
10' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
10' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
7' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) scores. Unfortunately for him, it's an own goal!
6' The flag is raised and Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is offside again, not for the first time today.
5' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
5' A cross into the box from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
4' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
3' Flag goes up against Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will officiate today.
